initialBuild.title: Fishing Active / AFK (Barb) 100+
initialBuild.description:
Do not level your fishing skill higher than your MMan's fishing skill.

## Rage_Basics

Max Brute Efficiency, Fist of Rage, and Idle Skilling in that order.
*1 Leftover points can be put into LUK, AGI or WIS.

## Warrior

Max Firmly Grasp It, Absolute Unit and Tempestuous Emotions in that order. Points can also be put into 'Str'ess Tested Garb if more STR is desired.

## Barbarian

Max Worming Undercover, STR Summore, Strongest Statues, All Fish Diet and Catching Some ZZZ's.
*1 Level it up to your minigame score 
*2 Excess can be used to improve STR.
